title: Draw Thou My Soul, O Christ * /
firstLine: Draw Thou my soul, O Christ, closer to thine;

lines: Draw Thou my soul, O Christ, closer to thine;
Breathe into ev'ry wish thy will divine;
O Christ, Thro' min let thy life shine.
Lead forth my soul, O Christ, one with Thine own,
Joyful to follow thee thro' paths unknown;
Give me thy work to do;
Thy truth be shown, Thy love made known.
Not for myself alone may my prayer be;
Lift Thou thy world, O Christ, closer to Thee;
Cleanse it from guilt and wrong;
Till earth fulfill God's holy will.
